description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the app's main process (Node inspector) and returns its JSON value. `require` is available, e.g. require('electron').BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().map(w => w.getTitle()). Promises are awaited. Needs main=true in list_windows.

app.description: App: id (its CDP port) or name from list_windows. Optional with a single app.

name: evaluate_main
title: Evaluate in main process
